_doc: Evidence-named variables for PLBATTLE (lane mod-plbattle). Key = DS address hex (A<base> arrays, SUB<addr> near subroutines, FN<addr>/FN<addr>_args DEF FN inlining); <key>_why = evidence (listing offsets). Addresses below 0x40F4 are elements of the COMMON array G! (index = (addr-0x1850)/4); 0x40F4..0x7FAA = other COMMON variables; above = PLBATTLE locals. ENCINFO columns are numbered 1..27 in file order (name$, then 27 integers). A<base>_count = element count of a static local array (evidence in A<base>_why); qb2bas renders every direct DS address inside an array range (COMMON descriptors or A<base>_count) as the element `Name(index)` - a constant index the compiler folded into a direct operand (sweep-folded, 2026-10-16); such addresses therefore carry no name key, only a _why.
